description: Mounted in Snowbirds colours at the Moose Jaw Visitor Centre beside the Trans-Canada Highway, installed in 2009 with support from Western Economic Diversification, 15 Wing and the City of Moose Jaw, to mark the city's association with the Snowbirds. This is the town display and is distinct from 114021 at the Western Development Museum and 114036 on 15 Wing.
museum_name: Moose Jaw Visitor Centre CT-114 Tutor, Moose Jaw
